definitions.bridgeRequestToT3Requested: Trace request.at to the existing childRun recentRuns.requestedAt. It measures the observed interval before T3 recorded the request, not a known individual polling, approval or transport component.
definitions.t3RequestedToStarted: T3 recentRun.requestedAt to startedAt. Scheduler and provider start wait are not separately observed.
definitions.providerRunStartedToCompleted: T3 recentRun.startedAt to completedAt. Provider-run wall time is not provider internal computation or token generation time.
definitions.t3CompletedToTraceReply: T3 recentRun.completedAt to actual trace reply.at. Missing actual reply is UNKNOWN, not zero.
definitions.clippedToTrialWindowMs: Interval intersections with the first trace request.at through frozen trace done.at. Provider time after the frozen trial ended is excluded from this partition.
definitions.localTransitionsAndUnmappedRemainderMs: Trial window minus observed partition intervals. No internal component is inferred.

minimumExecutionPathRecommendations.proposal: Check the frozen trial deadline before requesting a new delegated task and suppress delegation for an expired trial.
minimumExecutionPathRecommendations.acceptanceImpact: Prevents unnecessary post-deadline model work. Does not change the frozen timeout classification or elapsed cap.

minimumExecutionPathRecommendations.proposal: Dispatch each bridge request promptly and record request-ready, poll-observed, approval-returned, T3-requested, provider-started, completed and reply-delivered times.
minimumExecutionPathRecommendations.acceptanceImpact: Targets the observed pre-T3 interval and makes its components diagnosable. No claimed improvement until measured.

minimumExecutionPathRecommendations.proposal: When approval rejects a request, record the rejection immediately and propagate an explicit transport failure to the driver instead of leaving a reserved request pending until timeout.
minimumExecutionPathRecommendations.acceptanceImpact: Needs implementation review for the next epoch. Do not rewrite the old model_timeout results or alter scoring criteria.

minimumExecutionPathRecommendations.proposal: Retain the elapsed cap and separately record a child run that outlives the trial. A polling-only change cannot be claimed to solve the observed graph provider-run interval.
minimumExecutionPathRecommendations.acceptanceImpact: No change to model selection, protocol budget or acceptance criteria is proposed by this audit.
